Grain
CPI operates 25 grain facilities in Nebraska with a total storage capacity of close to 120 million bushels. We are constantly investing in upgrades to ensure we have modern, efficient, and safe facilities. Our strategically placed train-loading facilities enables grain shipments to export or domestic markets. Our facilities are also located close to a multitude of local markets to help facilitate the movement of grain and satisfy local demand.
CPI Direct Ship
In today's volatile and competitive grain market, managing your position can be time-consuming, often resulting in undervalued products. By enrolling in the CPI Direct program, our team of marketers and originators is committed to assisting you in navigating these challenges, ensuring you secure the best deal for your grain while maximizing its value for your operation. Whether we handle the logistics with our fleet of trucks picking up grain from your bin site, or you choose to deliver the grain yourself, the service guarantees the most competitive price that CPI can offer for your grain.
CPI Cash Grain Contracts
We offer the following grain contract options at CPI.
DP (Delayed Pricing)
DP contracts are utilized by the buyer to help get ownership during harvest or to help facilitate the movement of grain from farm storage to grain elevators during the winter/spring.
Bushel Only/OTC
Contact your Grain Originator for more information.
Basis Contract
This contract authorizes the customer to lock in a basis for a specified delivery time, quantity and location. This enables the customer to capture what would be an attractive strong basis and stop monthly charges. One drawback to this contract is that no price protection is afforded, as the futures price has not been established yet.
Futures Only (HTA) Contract
This allows the seller to lock in a futures price for a specified delivery time, quantity and location. It enables the customer to establish a futures selling price that is attractive to them and within the pricing restrictions of the contract; they can price the basis at a later date. There is a service charge associated with this, due at the time of contract settlement, which varies depending upon commodity and length of time until the contract matures.
Firm Offer
A customer can leave an offer to sell grain at a price they want for a specific delivery period under this option. This offer can be for any delivery period that we currently have a bid for; it can be left as a good-to-cancel offer, or for any time up to 30 days. The minimum amount for this contract is 500 bushels.
Extended Price Contract
This option allows the customer to deliver bushels and eliminate monthly charges while staying in the market and receiving partial payment. The customer will sell their cash grain and buy a July futures position that CPI will attach to their contract. There is no price protection, as all risk is in the July futures market. A service charge of 3 cents per bushel applies.
Average Seasonal Futures Only Price Contract
This contract takes the emotion and hassle out of a marketing decision by automatically executing on the customer's behalf. The seller will receive an average futures price in a window when historical seasonal values are typically the highest, allowing the customer to set their basis at a later date. There is a 5 cent per bushel service charge, due at the time of settlement.
Minimum Price Contract
This option allows the customer to deliver bushels and eliminate monthly charges while staying in the market and receiving Minimum Price payment. The customer sells their cash grain and selects a futures month strike price and premium price of a CALL option. Option premium plus a 3 cent service fee is subtracted from the cash grain price to establish the floor "Minimum Price."
